[b][size=4]DESCRIPTION[/size][/b]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
If you tab out during menu transitions or the end-of-day screen, your game pauses.
This mod fixes* the always active logic so it actually works everywhere you'd expect.

[b][color=#f1c232]This mod will not work if you select "Pause When Game Window Is Inactive".[/color][/b]

[b][size=4]TECHNICAL[/size][/b]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
Uses a single Harmony postfix and no platform-specific dependencies. Also stops framerate throttling.
Other mods use non-native methods or Windows binaries, which generated a 34MB log on Linux for me.

There is also a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Configuration Menu[/url].
This menu often questions why it even exists...
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
